name: Frozen Fear Trap (CR 5)
body:
Frozen Fear Trap
CR 5

Type magical; Perception DC 29; Disable Device DC 29

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset automatic
Effect spell effect fear, 7th-level cleric, DC 16 Will negates.

A young lumberjack frozen in the wall stares out of his icy tomb; anyone gazing upon his face is suddenly struck with icy terror.
